user_query: Analyze this very short protein sequence for sequence properties, membrane topology/localization, homologs, domains, and likely biological function. Pay special attention to whether it is a single-pass or multi-pass membrane protein, a signal peptide, or a small membrane-associated regulatory protein. Do not overclaim function from short-sequence homology.

warnings: Sequence-derived estimates assume an unmodified protein and do not account for processing, PTMs, bound ligands, or oligomers.

annotation_comments.text: PSII is composed of 1 copy each of membrane proteins PsbA, PsbB, PsbC, PsbD, PsbE, PsbF, PsbH, PsbI, PsbJ, PsbK, PsbL, PsbM, PsbT, PsbX, PsbY, PsbZ, Psb30/Ycf12, peripheral proteins PsbO, CyanoQ (PsbQ), PsbU, PsbV and a large number of cofactors. It forms dimeric complexes.
